sponsor_season_description: Support a full season of productions across PYT, with recognition across all material, tickets and benefits.
matching_note: Many employers match charitable gifts dollar-for-dollar - search yours here to see if they do.
intro_body: We're raising $200,000 in 2026. PYT is a nonprofit organization that relies on donations. Participation fees cover 80% of operating costs, the rest comes from the generosity of individuals, families, and corporate sponsors. Every gift brings theater and community to the Bay Area and beyond!
sponsor_show_description: Back a single production, and receive (optional) recognition, tickets, and benefits for that title.
